fixtures.description: A short-pattern episode straddles Africa/Lagos midnight; pay is always split by day while policy-state reset follows the selected scope.

A.payable: Rate-tier seconds remain day-split. Detector state carries across midnight only when RD_RESET_SCOPE=trip; lagos_day starts fresh state.
A.excluded: Confirmed rolling-stationary time after the shared grace, according to the selected reset scope.
A.explanation: Africa/Lagos day boundary is explicit, never UTC or implicit

B.payable: Each day keeps its own rate tier. Budget carries only when CSB_SCOPE=trip; lagos_day restores a new budget at midnight.
B.excluded: Candidate seconds above the selected scope budget.

C.held: Evidence and hold carry across midnight only when HOLD_SCOPE=trip; lagos_day evaluates each day independently.
C.explanation: hold scope is explicit and immutable in the assessment revision

fixtures.description: A normalized stationary episode observed at a dense ping cadence.

A.payable: Identical to ping_cadence_sparse for the same normalized rolling observables.
A.excluded: Equal displacement is stationary because the boundary is inclusive; grace applies once.
A.explanation: classification depends on elapsed time/displacement, not ping count

B.payable: Identical to ping_cadence_sparse; elapsed candidate seconds, not ping count, consume budget.
B.excluded: Long-vs-short boundary and budget use elapsed seconds.

C.payable: Identical gross payable time to ping_cadence_sparse.
C.held: Identical because evidence uses elapsed seconds and unique episodes, not ping count.

fixtures.description: The same normalized stationary episode as ping_cadence_dense, observed at a sparse ping cadence.

A.payable: Identical to ping_cadence_dense for the same normalized rolling observables.
A.excluded: Equal displacement is stationary because the boundary is inclusive; grace applies once.
A.explanation: classification depends on elapsed time/displacement, not ping count

B.payable: Identical to ping_cadence_dense; elapsed candidate seconds, not ping count, consume budget.
B.excluded: Long-vs-short boundary and budget use elapsed seconds.

C.payable: Identical gross payable time to ping_cadence_dense.
C.held: Identical because evidence uses elapsed seconds and unique episodes, not ping count.

fixtures.description: The same physical 300-second sub-window episode as ping_cadence_dense, split into three consecutive 100-second segments that continue one episode (same episode_id and episode_duration_seconds).

A.payable: Not an option-A invariance proof: rolling_relation labels are normalized fixture inputs, so this abstraction cannot demonstrate RD_WINDOW_S partition invariance.
A.excluded: Whatever the labeled equal windows confirm after grace; FND-02B production tests must prove elapsed-time normalization on real traces.
A.explanation: option-A partition invariance is deferred to FND-02B production evidence

B.payable: Identical to ping_cadence_dense for any budget: elapsed candidate seconds spend the budget in the same order regardless of segment partition.
B.excluded: Identical to ping_cadence_dense; only elapsed seconds above the budget are excluded.

C.payable: Identical gross payable time to ping_cadence_dense.
C.held: Identical because elapsed seconds sum identically and the continued episode_id keeps one unique episode.

fixtures.description: Exact equality probes: rolling displacement equals its threshold; cumulative candidate time reaches its budget; hold evidence reaches its trigger.

A.payable: Equal displacement is stationary; only shared grace and unconfirmed windows remain payable.
A.excluded: Confirmed equality windows after grace are stationary_rolling_displacement.

B.payable: Candidate time through exactly CSB_BUDGET_SECONDS remains payable.
B.excluded: Only time strictly above the budget is stationary_subwindow_budget_exceeded.

C.payable: Existing-classifier gross payable time is unchanged.
C.held: The scope is held when seconds or episode evidence equals the selected inclusive trigger.

fixtures.description: Alternating below/above/equal rolling windows expose confirmation and release hysteresis without hiding the owner-selected counts.

A.payable: Depends exactly on RD_CONFIRM_WINDOWS and RD_RELEASE_WINDOWS; qualifying and release runs are backdated to their run starts.
A.excluded: Only windows confirmed stationary after shared grace.
A.explanation: jitter behavior is explicit rather than an implicit implementation detail

B.payable: First min(total short-candidate seconds, CSB_BUDGET_SECONDS) remain payable regardless of jitter labels.
B.explanation: option B intentionally ignores rolling jitter

C.payable: All valid seconds are gross-payable before hold.
C.held: The inclusive evidence trigger determines the whole-scope hold.
C.explanation: option C intentionally treats the pattern as review evidence
